posts.title: 3-years-of-Taino-Bay!
posts.description: Wow! Life has truly passed us by, hasn't it? December marks our 3rd anniversary! And what a ride it has been.
posts.content:
Wow! Life has truly passed us by, hasn't it? December marks our 3rd anniversary! And what a ride it has been. Arriving to the beautiful Bride of the Atlantic has been something magic and we are proud to have grown here. Creating lifetime experiences has been a passion for us always, and you can see it in Taino Bay.

During this time, we have grown so much! These are some of our the experiences we have created for you on these past few years!:

Lazy River: The top spot for relaxing while having fun. Grab a floatie and let yourself go!
Splash Surfing: In the mood for surf? This wave simmulator is available for you to enjoy upon arrival. It is located on our brand new beach-inspired area.
Icekery: Dominican heat is strong! The best way to fight it is while having a delicious ice cream. At Icekery you'll find delicious flavors and toppings to enjoy.
Mr Rum's Quest: A rum and tobacco experience you'll remember forever! Discover the adventure of Mr. Rum and taste the delicious Dominican rum.
Of course, we can't forget to mention our restaurants and bars, that are always ready to serve fresh food and a unique taste to everything.

To many more! <3

posts.title: Lets-Make-a-Splash-Together!
posts.description: We’re thrilled to invite you to enjoy unforgettable moments in our new beach area! This vibrant space allows cruisers to experience a beach day right at the port, complete with board games, lounge chairs, and, of course, the excitement of Splash Surfing.
posts.content:
We’re thrilled to invite you to enjoy unforgettable moments in our new beach area! This vibrant space allows cruisers to experience a beach day right at the port, complete with board games, lounge chairs, and, of course, the excitement of Splash Surfing.

Splash Surfing is our wave simulator, where kids and adults can test their surfing skills and enjoy the rush. It’s the perfect way to add some thrill to your day at the harbor!

We can’t wait to share this amazing experience with you. Don't forget to capture the fun and tag us in your photos—let’s relive those memories together!

posts.title: Pride-celebration-at-Taino-Bay
posts.description: June was a fantastic month! Throughout June, we commemorated Pride Month with events, and activities that celebrate the community.
posts.content:
June was a fantastic month! Throughout June, we commemorated Pride Month with events, and activities that celebrate the community. Diversity, equity, and acceptance are values that drive our commitment to creating a welcoming environment. It is a must for us to foster a space where both employees and visitors feel valued, respected, and happy.

We had a great time celebrating with you!

posts.title: Icekery-is-OPEN!
posts.description: Last May 15, we had a blast, enjoying delicious ice cream at the brand new Icekery at the port. This fun ice cream shop offer a delicious artisanal ice cream variety for those who want to beat the Dominican heat.
posts.content:
Last May 15, we had a blast, enjoying delicious ice cream at the brand new Icekery at the port. This fun ice cream shop offer a delicious artisanal ice cream variety for those who want to beat the Dominican heat.

You can custom your ice cream by choosing your favorite toppings. From gummy bears, to chocolate sticks, and cookies, you can make it as yummy as you wish.

Icekery is easy to find upon arrival...It is right in front of Monkey Island!

So here you have it. After enjoying a day filled with adventure, visit Icekery and freshen up before heading back to your cruise!
